dossier_meta.statement_text: We do not know whether the factor 2 is unavoidable in the bound of Lemma 4, which states that every tree of pathwidth $k$ has a path-partition of height at most $2k$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Lemma 4 is a key structural tool used in the proof of Theorem 2. The authors note that they made no effort to optimise the bound and leave open whether the factor 2 can be reduced.
